# netskope_npa_private_app_tags_list (Data Source)

NPAPrivateAppTagsList DataSource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netskope_npa_private_app_tags_list" "my_npaprivateapptagslist" {
  limit  = 9
  offset = 0
  query  = "...my_query..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `limit` (Number) Number of results to return
- `offset` (Number) Query offset
- `query` (String) Filter expression (e.g. "tag_name has foo", "tag_name sw bar")

### Read-Only

- `tags` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `tag_id` (Number) Tag ID (API-assigned). Reference this value in NPA Real-Time Protection rules via privateAppTagIds.
- `tag_name` (String) Tag name. Must be unique per tenant. Private apps reference this tag by name on create/update; the API resolves the name to tag_id.
